name: Agaru Tattoo & Body Piercing
bio: Nestled in the heart of Wilmington, Agaru Tattoo & Body Piercing is an avant-garde studio specializing in the bold and vibrant trashpolka style. With locations at 13B Trolley Square and 413 S. Maryland Avenue, the elite team – including talents like @tjdelanytattoo, @lindsaymarieapril, @vihkay, and @cloudiatattoo – is dedicated to crafting striking and unique body art in a creatively inspiring environment. Whether it's ink or piercings, Agaru is your destination for an edgy and personalized expression.
